name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: A message bubble from the dashboard's support chat: brand blue for the person's own, the subtle gray for the team's.
usage: Use inside Message for a conversation: support chat, an agent's replies. `default` for the person's own messages (align end), `secondary` for the other side, `outline` for a typing or loading bubble, `muted` for a system line, `tinted` for a highlighted reply, `destructive` for a message that failed. BubbleGroup stacks consecutive bubbles; BubbleReactions pins reactions to an edge.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
